import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.processors.base import BaseProcessor


class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor for PocketCoffea."""
    
    def object_preselection(self, variation: str) -> None:
        """Create MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4."""
        muons = self.events.Muon
        muon_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)

        """Store the number of selected muons per event."""
        self.events["n_muons"] = ak.num(self.events.MuonGood)

import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.processors.base import BaseProcessor


class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor for PocketCoffea."""
    
    def object_preselection(self, variation: str) -> None:
        """Create MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4."""
        muons = self.events.Muon
        muon_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        self.events["MuonGood"] = muons[muon_mask]
    
    def object_counting(self, variation: str) -> None:
        """Store the number of selected muons per event."""
        self.events["n_muons"] = ak.num(self.events.MuonGood)
